from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper extracted from the document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the paper as it appears in the document")
    references: List[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted papers from the collection."""
    papers: List[Paper]
